svg.aria-label: Terminal replay of scripts/demo_full.sh: a 2-shard replicated DistCache cluster routes keys, rate-limits, survives kill -9 of a primary, rejoins it as a replica and rebalances live
svg.title: DistCache end-to-end demo (real output of scripts/demo_full.sh)
svg.text: scripts/demo_full.sh: 2 shards x (1 primary + 2 replicas), sync replication, WAL, router (real output)

g.text: == 1. Start the cluster: 2 shards (a, b), each 1 primary + 2 replicas, sync replication, WAL, one router
cluster is up: redis-cli -p 7000 (logs and data in /tmp/distcache-demo)
shard:a state=healthy primary=a#0 epoch=0 failovers=0 failures=0 lease_wait_ms=1300
shard:b state=healthy primary=b#0 epoch=0 failovers=0 failures=0 lease_wait_ms=1300
== 2. ROUTING: keys are spread over the shards by consistent hashing
each shard's primary holds its own share (the router's DBSIZE sums both):
== 3. REPLICATION: every write is on a replica before the client hears OK (--repl-sync 1)
replica a2 serves reads but refuses writes:
READONLY You can't write against a read only replica.
the primary's view of its replicas:
== 4. RATE LIMITING: a token bucket of 5 tokens (no meaningful refill) stored as a key on shard a
bucket rl:tenant2 lives on shard: a
the bucket is replicated: RL.PEEK on replica a2 agrees (advisory read, nothing consumed):
== 5. FAILOVER: kill -9 the primary of shard a while writing
writes to shard a work again after 1.390331434 s
shard:a state=healthy primary=a#1 epoch=1 failovers=1 failures=0 lease_wait_ms=1298
shard:b state=healthy primary=b#0 epoch=0 failovers=0 failures=0 lease_wait_ms=1300
+2771ms [a] PROMOTED a#1 to epoch 1 at offset 154 (2 eligible)
nothing acknowledged was lost, TTLs and the rate limiter's state survived:
the bucket was empty before the crash and still is (a forgotten token would show as 'allowed'):
== 6. REJOIN: the old primary comes back; it must not accept writes and must resynchronise
a1 is now a replica of the new primary and refuses writes:
READONLY You can't write against a read only replica.
== 7. LIVE REBALANCING (Phase 7): add a third shard with MIGRATE while data is live
OK scanned=303 moved=97 superseded=0 vanished=0 errors=0
keys now on the new shard c: 97
the rate-limit bucket is still empty (state moved with the key if it moved):
OK scanned=97 moved=97 superseded=0 vanished=0 errors=0
== Done. Shutting the cluster down cleanly.
